name: xenarch
summary: Xenarch is the non-custodial payment SDK for the agentic internet. Pay for any HTTP 402–gated resource with USDC micropayments on Base L2 (xenarch.x402), and get paid — create and manage pay-links, read payments and subscribers, verify webhooks (xenarch.merchant). Works for humans in scripts and AI agents in workflows. 0% Xenarch fee. Gasless: the wallet only ever holds USDC — no gas coin needed.
